case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praised the breakfast (described as divine, extensive, very good, wonderful), though some noted issues with the orange juice and espresso taste and limited day-to-day variety. Cleanliness and comfortable, functional rooms were frequently commended, along with friendly reception/staff and good facilities including a buffet/pool. Reported negatives included a preference for a double bed instead of two singles and a missing bidet shower in one bathroom.
